IS-001.reason: configure_postgresql never drops a cluster with user data. The user-database count is taken once while the cluster runs (pg_database, excluding templates and postgres) with an on-disk base/ fallback. Case 1 uses $USE_SUDO test -f, so a non-root run sees an initialized target, and it prints a NOTICE when it switches away from a dir that holds user databases (kept on disk). Case 2 calls pg_dropcluster only when that count is exactly 0; otherwise it prints ACTION REQUIRED, restarts the stopped service and returns 1. pg_keep_existing_cluster keeps the current cluster when the target is empty and the current one is missing or used.

IS-012.reason: pg_resolve_target_dirs is the single resolver for configure_postgresql and pg_expected_data_dir (WSL image or native, else the mapped POSIX path, else compile_dir). pg_config_value parses quoted values with trailing comments, which removes the false need_recreate. pg_data_dir_drifted reports drift only when the reconcile loses nothing, so a kept cluster is not restarted on every run.

IS-002.reason: Step93/94/96 use "Step ${STEP_NUMBER}: ..." (the Step175 form), so the scope-qualified-variable parse error is gone.

IS-003.reason: gitput_security_common.sh step 6 is opt-in (GITPUT_SHARE_SSH_KEY_WITH_USERS, default false, declared in gitput_unified.sh). It copies only when the user has no key of that name, and a different existing key is kept and reported. Step 3 backs up the SSH_DIR key pair before every --force decrypt.

IS-004.reason: Remove-PathMappingLinkLocation sends reparse points (junctions and symlinks) to Remove-PathMappingJunction, which calls [System.IO.Directory]::Delete(path, $false) and removes only the link. A stale junction first merges the old target into the new one with the non-overwriting robocopy (/XC /XN /XO), skipped when either path contains the other. The em dashes in two double-quoted strings are replaced with ASCII (IS-006 class).
